answer.rationale: Verify memory_c4 because incumbent renegotiation at renewal is the main basis for the intended action; it is the strongest candidate for reducing TCO while preserving continuity. This remains uncertain until the verified record and supplier response are known; if terms cannot close before expiry, a short continuity extension is required.
